description: gatecub for Codex: adds what `gatecub context` prints at the start of a session, refuses, with the reason, a git call that skips the hooks, a gatecub call that turns the gate off, or a patch of gatecub.toml, a hook file, the git configuration or a record of gatecub, because Codex cannot ask from a hook, and gives `gatecub tokens record` the notice that a role or the session has ended. The commands for sh run gatecub only from an entry of PATH that is an absolute path. The commands for Windows go to the root of the session's drive and then to the Windows folder before they run gatecub, so a relative entry of PATH is read from there and not from the session's directory. Every command exits 0, so an old or missing gatecub blocks nothing. The git hooks decide about commits and pushes; this file does not.

hooks.command: sh -c 'p=; IFS=:; set -f; for d in $PATH; do case "$d" in /*) p="${p:+$p:}$d";; esac; done; unset IFS; set +f; [ -n "$p" ] || exit 0; PATH=$p; c=$(command -v gatecub 2>/dev/null); [ -x "$c" ] || c=; case "$c" in /*) "$c" context --host codex;; *) if [ -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/gatecub.toml" ]; then echo "gatecub is not installed, so every commit and every push in this repository will be denied by its git hooks. The install instruction is at https://github.com/belevtsev/gatecub#install"; fi;; esac; true'
hooks.commandWindows: set NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1& pushd .& cd \& cd /d %SystemRoot% && (gatecub context --host codex 2>nul & if errorlevel 9009 (popd & if exist gatecub.toml echo gatecub is not installed, so every commit and every push in this repository will be denied by its git hooks. The install instruction is at https://github.com/belevtsev/gatecub#install)) & exit /b 0

hooks.commandWindows: set NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1& cd \& cd /d %SystemRoot% && gatecub guard --host codex 2>nul & exit /b 0
